## Important Notices

##### **Visa Bond Update**

Starting January 21, 2026, nationals of Bangladesh who are found otherwise eligible for a B1/B2 visa must post a bond of up to \$15,000. At the time of the interview, the consular officer will inform the applicant whether they are eligible for a visa and will provide instructions on how to pay this bond. Applicants must not use any third-party website for posting the bond, nor pay a bond before instructed to do so by a consular officer. B1/B2 visas for nationals of Bangladesh cannot be issued until the bond has been paid. This requirement applies regardless of place of application.

##### 

##### **Double-Check Your Information Immediately:**

Please double-check that the barcode number on your DS-160 form matches the one you used to schedule your appointment. [Access instructions on updating your DS-160 number](https://assets.ctfassets.net/pitqj5emwdvc/2V9pGCoDPuBoOmdCFZVTY6/2699f0aa28022b4f8463b49fe43d8b74/Instructions_on_Changing_DS-160.pdf).

Starting May 1, 2025, all visa applicants must bring a DS-160 visa application form with a confirmation/barcode number (starting with AA) that matches the one used to make their appointment online. If you appear at your appointment and the DS-160 barcode does not match the one in your appointment profile, you will not be able to attend your interview.

##### 

##### **Instruction on DS-160 Form for Nonimmigrant Visa Applicants:**

In order to increase the number of visa appointments, all nonimmigrant visa applicants are required to complete and submit their DS-160 visa applications online and update their profiles at *[www.ustraveldocs.com/bd/en](https://www.ustraveldocs.com/bd/en/)* more than 7 calendar days before the visa interview date. ***Submissions within 7 days before the interview date will not be accepted***.

Please note, starting from December 15, 2024:

- Your non-immigrant visa interview ***will be cancelled*** if you DO NOT have a valid DS-160 confirmation (barcode) number on the day of your interview that we are able to retrieve in our system and which matches our manifest.  In that case, you will need to re-schedule your interview and may have to wait couple of months to get a new date;
- The valid DS-160 confirmation (barcode) number must be reflected in your online profile;
- Any changes in the online profile/*[DS-160](https://ceac.state.gov/GenNIV/Default.aspx)* within a week (7 calendar days) before the visa interview will result in the cancellation of the interview appointment. Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

## Overview

Nonimmigrant visas are for international travelers coming to the United States temporarily. The visa, placed in your passport when issued, allows you to travel to a port of entry and request the permission of the Department of Homeland Security Customs and Border Protection immigration officer to enter the United States. A visa does not guarantee entry. International travelers come to the United States for a wide variety of reasons, including tourism, business, medical treatment, and certain types of temporary work. For an overview of the types of nonimmigrant visas available, please see [directory of nonimmigrant visa categories](https://www.ustraveldocs.com/bd/en/step-1#visa-types).

Advance planning can smooth the visa application process for you. Apply for your visa well in advance of your travel!

## Nonimmigrant Visas Information

[How to Apply](#v996v-pills-1 "How to Apply")

\
Make your [appointment](https://www.ustraveldocs.com/bd/en/step-2#how-to-apply-for-non-immigrant-visa) through [www.ustraveldocs.com/bd/en](https://www.ustraveldocs.com/bd/en/) website or by contacting our call center. Create a user account to make an appointment for visa interview at the Embassy.\
Watch the video of Apply the Right Way, Apply the Smart Way!

[Qualification Requirements](#v996v-pills-2 "Qualification Requirements")

A passport valid for six months beyond the period of your intended stay in the United States. Children must have an individually issued visa, even if placed in a parent’s passport. Applicants for visitor visas must show that they qualify under provisions of the Immigration and Nationality Act. Applicants must demonstrate that they are properly classifiable as visitors under U.S. law.

[](https://bd.usembassy.gov/qualification-requirements/ "Qualification Requirements")

Learn More about Qualification Requirements

[Interview Steps](#v996v-pills-3 "Interview Steps")

\
Watch the instructional video on fingerprinting

[](https://bd.usembassy.gov/interview-steps/ "Interview Steps")

Learn about the Interview Steps

[Supporting Documents](#v996v-pills-4 "Supporting Documents")

Each person applying for a U.S. visa come to their interview with their

- Passport, valid for at least 6 months beyond their intended stay in the  U.S.
- Machine Readable Visa (MRV) fee payment receipt – EBL Bank Cashier receipt (if paid in cash), the screenshot of the successful transaction confirmation detail after the EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) payment through BEFTN (Bangladesh Electronic Funds Transfer Network) or EBL Skybanking application, proof of payment through Credit/Debit Card, or online payment via Elavon with Credit/Debit card in USD. For more information, please visit this [website](https://www.ustraveldocs.com/bd/en/payment-options).
- DS-160 application confirmation page
- Appointment confirmation letter

Please note that children must have their own passports.

[](https://bd.usembassy.gov/supporting-documents/ "Supporting Documents")

## Contact Us

**Email:**

- [Support-bangladesh@usvisascheduling.com](mailto:support-bangladesh@usvisascheduling.com) (for all nonimmigrant visa inquiries)
- <DhakaFraud@state.gov>; <fraud@ustraveldocs.com> (for visa fraud or malfeasance)

**Phone:**

- Within **Bangladesh:** [+880-9610202040](tel:+880%209610-202040)
- Within the **United States:** [+1-703-988-3466](tel:(703)%20988-3466)

**No inquiries will be accepted by fax or letter mail;**

Documents mailed to us through Bangladesh mail will be shredded upon receipt;

Documents mailed to us through international mail will be abandoned at Bangladesh Customs; we are unable to pay any fees to retrieve them.  Any personal identifiable information contained in such documents will be abandoned at the sender’s own risk.
